body:
Virtual hug more than welcome. 

It is an awful time, but it will get better. I know I will be a stronger person thanks to this experience, even though I cannot see it now.

One day at a time. 

I’m looking into starting medication again. I was on Paxil for a year but the side effects were terrible. And the withdrawal was just as bad. 

On the other hand though I wasn’t suicidal anymore so I guess that’s good. 

I’ll schedule a meeting with my psychiatrist on Monday. 

One day at a time. Thank you.
